name: Habits
description: A private habit, training & reflection tracker for Standard Notes: check-off or count habits, with an optional per-habit workout log (distance, time, RPE) that rolls up in a Training view (weekly volume + trends). Today / Calendar / Training / Stats / Insights / Journal views, a daily progress ring, 7-day momentum strips, streaks, a reflective journal (prompts, mood, search, on-this-day), gamification (XP, levels, achievement badges), a local Insights dashboard, and a note-size health guardrail. All data is stored inside the note and protected by Standard Notes' end-to-end encryption.
